data.body:
Plan review round 1 returned BLOCK on COH + G6, both pointing at the same gap: the plan dropped the epic +2 clarity bonus without showing the resulting score arithmetic.

Verified empirically against the real _clarity_score rather than estimating:
- epic fixture today (with SC block): 440 chars, score 6
- SC block removed, bonus DROPPED: 412 chars, score 4 -- BELOW the default threshold of 5, so test_clarity_pass_implies_check_ac_pass[epic] goes RED and the fixture would need padding past 500 chars
- SC block removed, bonus REPOINTED to Acceptance Criteria: score 6, unchanged

Changed the approach from DROP to REPOINT. Repointing makes the epic bonus automatic (AC is already a universal blocking floor), so clarity-check stops discriminating for epics -- accepted deliberately, since clarity-check is slated for removal. The decisive argument against dropping is not the fixture: dropping lowers EVERY real epic in the store by 2, risking a live clarity regression across the 108 tickets this epic migrates, for the sake of a metric being deleted.

Plan now carries the measured arithmetic and an AC asserting _clarity_score(fixture,'epic')==6, so the repoint is proven score-neutral instead of assumed.
